verdicts.reason: A shrinks both decorative circles. The top-right one now floats loose inside the canvas, crowding the can, instead of bleeding off the edge, so the original's framing is lost. All the content is packed into the top 70%, leaving a big dead band between the CTA and the tiny legal line, which sits awkwardly beside the shrunken bottom circle. B keeps the large circles bleeding off the edges as in the original, and the logo, can, headline and CTA stack is better centred vertically. Its flaws: the GLACIER logo now sits fully on top of the circle, the top margin is oversized, and the small, hard-to-read legal text floats at mid-low height on the edge of the bottom circle instead of being anchored to the bottom.
